questions.stem: The symmetric of I(2; 1; 2) with respect to the plane x − y − 2z − 5 = 0 is a point J. The midpoint of [IJ] is the intersection of (IJ) with that plane. A direction of (IJ) is:
solutionSketch: The line joining a point to its symmetric with respect to a plane is orthogonal to the plane.
Hence a direction of (IJ) is the normal (1;−1;−2).
